size.note: Newman's Birds gives 32 cm on the Crested Francolin page.

summary: The colour key says rufous brown above, with black-and-white facial marks, a well-spotted light brown breast and red legs. The description paragraph on this page is the Harlequin Quail account, so it was not used. Status, months and voice are unset. Newman’s page uses Dendroperdix sephaena. This file keeps Ortygornis sephaena. The Kemp code RB was left unchanged.

sources.title: Kemp A.C., Herholdt J.J., Whyte I. & Harrison J. (2001). Birds of the two largest national parks in South Africa: a method to generate estimates of population size for all species and assess their conservation ecology. S. Afr. J. Sci. 97: 393–403.

population.notes: Kemp et al. 2001 order-of-magnitude threshold 2^14=16384 mature individuals (resident breeder); paper interval half–double → 8192–32768.
